dyer.title: Prologue — Dyer’s warning
dyer.body: Professor William Dyer shows you the evidence he brought back from Antarctica. He wants you to help stop another expedition before it reaches the city he and Danforth found beyond the mountains.

convinced.title: Prologue — Dyer agrees
convinced.body: You argue that the expedition must understand what Dyer found. He agrees to accompany the team and asks you to tell Dr. Kensler.

doubted.title: Prologue — Dyer joins the expedition
doubted.body: You tell Dyer that you need to see the evidence for yourself. He decides to come with you.

team.title: Prologue — The expedition team
team.body: At the Boston docks, Dr. Amy Kensler leads the preparations aboard the Theodosia. Roald Ellsworth and James “Cookie” Fredericks handle the expedition gear, Takada Hiroko prepares the aircraft, Avery Claypool will guide the team, Dr. Mala Sinha oversees medical care, and Eliyah Ashevak looks after the dogs. Dyer and Danforth return to Antarctica with them.

antarctica.title: Ice and Death, Part I
antarctica.body: The Theodosia reaches Antarctica. After establishing a base camp, the expedition sets out in two planes to photograph the city and look for a safe place to land.

winifred.title: Introduction — Winifred takes the controls
winifred.body: Winifred Habbamock leads the flight. A sudden storm buffets both planes, and an immense shape appears in the clouds as she fights for control.

flight.title: Introduction — The flight inland
flight.body: From the passenger cabin, you watch the mountains through the mist. A sudden storm throws both planes off course, and an immense shape looms above you.

crash.title: Introduction — The crash
crash.body: You regain consciousness in the burning wreckage. The expedition pulls you into the snow and searches for survivors.

victim08714.body: William Dyer died in the plane crash.

setup.title: Setup
setup.body: Begin at the Crash Site. Explore the coast and the mountains to find shelter. The uncharted locations enter play as you approach them.

coldWelcome.title: Under the Ice
coldWelcome.body: Someone calls you back to look at a trail of misshapen tracks. Before you can work out what left them, a twisted shape bursts from the snow and rushes toward you.

intoTheWhite.title: Terror of the Stars
intoTheWhite.body: The shape that brought down the planes returns. You see it through the snowfall, bearing down on the place you hoped would shelter you.

runningOutOfTime.title: Running Out of Time
runningOutOfTime.body: The storm is getting worse. You have to give up the search and take shelter wherever you can.

noResolution.title: No resolution
noResolution.body: The cold has overcome the expedition. With the search cut short, the team must make do with whatever shelter is close at hand.

resolution1.title: Resolution 1
resolution1.body: At last, the expedition makes camp. You take stock of the supplies you recovered and prepare to face the night.

disappearance.title: Checkpoint I: The Disappearance
disappearance.body: A cry wakes you in the night. You emerge to find the camp in disarray. Footprints lead away into the darkness, and some of the expedition may have disappeared.

disappearanceLeave.title: Checkpoint I: The Disappearance
disappearanceLeave.body: The expedition rests and gathers its equipment for the next leg of the journey.

disappearanceSearch.title: Checkpoint I: The Disappearance
disappearanceSearch.body: You gather your equipment and follow the tracks into the darkness to search for the missing members of the expedition.

partTwoIntro.title: The search
partTwoIntro.body: The storm has quieted just enough to follow the tracks. You set out from camp before the wind can erase them. Somewhere in the white, the missing members of the expedition are waiting.

partTwoSetup.title: Setup
partTwoSetup.body: Begin at the camp established in part one. The expedition retraces its route and searches the unexplored sites.

partTwoWind.title: A harsh wind blows
partTwoWind.body: The wind picks up and begins to bury the tracks. You stop for a moment to look for signs of the missing team.

partTwoChill.title: The chill of night
partTwoChill.body: The light fades and the cold deepens. You take one last look into the distance before continuing.

partTwoMadness.title: Madness and death
partTwoMadness.body: The wind cuts through your clothing and the darkness closes in. The search has gone on too long.

partTwoNoResolution.title: No resolution
partTwoNoResolution.body: Cold and exhaustion bring the search to an end. Anyone still out on the ice will have to find their own way back.

partTwoResolution.title: Resolution 1
partTwoResolution.body: Back at camp, you count the people you managed to bring home. The rest are still out there, beyond the circle of light.

search08527.title: Dead end
search08527.body: The tracks lead to a hollow filled with fresh snow. You turn back without finding anyone.

search08528.title: Cracks in the ice
search08528.body: Something shifts beneath your feet. You hurry away from the cracks, wondering how deep they go.

search08529.title: Somber remains
search08529.body: A torn coat and a pair of goggles jut out of the snow. The lenses are smeared with a dark substance.

search08530.title: Disappearing footprints
search08530.body: The footprints vanish in the open snow. When you turn around, the trail behind you has vanished too.

search08531.title: Dissected explorer
search08531.body: The tracks lead to a small cave. Inside you find the body of one of the missing explorers, with a wound that could only have been made deliberately.

search08532.title: Evil within
search08532.body: The ice cracks beneath the creature chasing you. It drops into the depths, and the snow settles over the opening.

search08533.title: Bloody evidence
search08533.body: At the end of the trail, you find an ice pick stained with frozen blood. You back away from the tracks.

search08534.title: Madness inside
search08534.body: The explorer stares through you, their face streaked with a dark substance. When you finally reach them, they ask what they were doing.

attack.title: Checkpoint II: The Attack
attack.body: You have barely rested when the ice cracks beneath the camp. The same piping cry rises again. The creatures are closing in.

attackFlee.title: Checkpoint II: The Attack
attackFlee.body: You grab what you can and flee toward the mountains. By the time you stop, the expedition is exhausted.

attackFight.title: Checkpoint II: The Attack
attackFight.body: You take up positions around the camp and prepare to fight the creatures coming through the ice.

partThreeIntro.title: Ice and Death, Part III
partThreeIntro.body: Through the binoculars you see the ice split open. Shapes rise from one fissure, then another, and begin to converge on the camp.

partThreeSetup.title: Setup
partThreeSetup.body: Start at the camp with no clues on it. Place the Seeping Nightmares at the sites listed for your camp.

partThreeManifestations.title: Manifestations of Evil
partThreeManifestations.body: The last shape rises from the fissure. The storm worsens, and the team braces itself for what comes next.

partThreeDepths.title: Icy Depths
partThreeDepths.body: The ice gives way beneath you. The camp and the creatures vanish behind a wall of snow.

partThreeNoResolution.title: No resolution
partThreeNoResolution.body: You escape through a whirl of ice and snow, exhausted and barely able to tell what is following you.

partThreeVictory.title: Resolution 1
partThreeVictory.body: The last creature dissolves into mist. You leave the camp and walk until you can no longer hear anything behind you.

partThreeEscape.title: Resolution 2
partThreeEscape.body: You cover your tracks as you leave the ice shelf and head deeper into the mountains.

restfulNight.title: Restful Night
restfulNight.body: For the first time since the crash, the wind gives you a moment to rest. You make your way between the tents to speak to the others and see what you can salvage for the journey.

restfulNightDawn.title: At dawn
restfulNightDawn.body: You pack the camp and turn toward the mountains. If you are to reach the place Dyer described, you will have to go on foot.

restfulNightDoor.title: The door
restfulNightDoor.body: You wake to find a door standing in the snow. A grey mist drifts through the frame. The camp is still around you, but something beyond the door seems familiar.

description: Survive the crash and find shelter before the Antarctic storm closes in.
